purpose: Read-only diagnosis of the first frozen broad Studio qualification failures; no package edits or reruns at the time of capture.

findings.case: imap repository flags preserve live reader and provider identities
findings.evidence: All body assertions completed; the only reported error is teardown waiting 15 seconds for owner.whenClosed. No navigation is exercised; expectedTarget is null, pending flag action remains null, and no held navigation owner exists.
findings.unresolved: Existing marker cannot distinguish host waiting for observer cancellation from delegate database close. Storage uses a background native SQLite isolate. An isolated unchanged case is approved after the broad run; instrument close stages only if needed. Do not extend the timeout or classify as a flake without evidence.

findings.case: EWS/Gmail/Graph delete survives metadata updates and cannot resurrect cached rows
findings.evidence: The shared fake provider advertises only MailCapability.mail and folders. Production disables Delete and refuses _delete without MailCapability.delete. Therefore no confirmation is opened when the test taps the disabled action.
findings.approved_correction: Advertise delete only in the deletion fixture; assert action and confirmation readiness before changing cached metadata.

findings.case: all four provider cached-mail button opens only the local mailbox
findings.evidence: SqliteStudioMailMailboxStore supports StudioMailSyncStore. The empty combined retained-folder view renders mailCacheRetainedEmpty; the tests wait for and expect mailCacheEmpty.
findings.approved_correction: Match the sync-capable retained-folder empty text and predicate.

findings.case: closing Mail ignores a pending file picker result
findings.evidence: Failure is the first pumpAndSettle after opening default native Mail at test line39. The saved-message pane, file picker, and Close action are never reached. Default credential-loading/autoconnect rendering has a live progress indicator.
findings.approved_correction: Use an explicit session credential store and autoConnectSavedAccount false to reach the intended file-picker lifecycle.

findings.case: native setup offers Gmail/Microsoft365/Exchange and exposes Exchange entry
findings.evidence: Tests tap provider setup immediately while default IMAP credential catalog loading is pending. Newly introduced credentialPending method/button guards suppress the provider launch.
findings.root_owned_resolution: Keep independent provider setup usable while unrelated IMAP credential catalog loads; add delayed-catalog regression instead of hiding this behavior in fixtures.

findings.case: choosing a preset clears old credentials and exposes app-password guidance
findings.evidence: The fixture injects a memory credential catalog but leaves automatic restoration enabled, then enters Password before catalog readiness. The restoration view temporarily replaces setup.
findings.root_owned_correction: Explicitly disable autoConnectSavedAccount for this manual-settings fixture and settle catalog readiness.
